scheme_name: Investment Promotion Scheme (IPS) for MSME Sector: Assistance For Entrepreneurship Under Skill Development
state: Dadra and Nagar Haveli & Daman and Diu
other_conditions: The unit may be a new or existing manufacturing or service unit undertaking expansion or diversification in the MSME sector
The unit must have commenced commercial production between 20‑05‑2022 and 19‑05‑2027
The unit must be located in the Union Territory of Dadra and Nagar Haveli & Daman and Diu
The entrepreneur must apply within six months of completing the training
benefits_summary: 75% of the course fee is covered, up to ₹1,50,000 per course for a maximum of 20 persons per year.
